parsed.summary: The PR adds a new parameter to customize the error code of ValidationError raised by BaseConstraint, which is a useful enhancement.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new parameter `violation_error_code` to the `__init__` method of `BaseConstraint`, which is a minor style inconsistency as it deviates from the existing parameter naming convention.
